text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? You want me on your soccer team?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I got invited to play on our day
off, and
we're looking for more
teammates!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I mean I like watching soccer, but I don't really have much experience playing it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you don't? But you were so good
in the mini
soccer match!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I-I was? I guess I did play a liiittle
soccer with
my dad as a kid.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, no wonder, then! That must be why
you had
such a lovely dribble form!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
L-lovely?! Oh gosh, you're being way
too kind!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, I really mean it! You were running
with that
ball like you'd been friends
with it forever. You
were so cool out
there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Really! That's why I figured you'd be a
super
strong addition to the team!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oooh... Well if you put it that way, I
guess I can
give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh! So you're game? Thanks so much!
